description: Shutdown cleanup committed Dustin Schaffer.pdf and Tim Brackney.pdf alongside their markdown source files. PDFs generated as reMarkable push artifacts are temp deliverables — the markdown is the canonical source. Both PDFs should have been deleted before commit, not committed.
correction: When a meetings PDF has a corresponding .md source file in the same directory, the PDF is a temp artifact and must be deleted before commit. The markdown is canonical; the PDF is a push/distribution artifact only.
systemic_fix: Update shutdown-cleanup/steps/step-02-organize-deliverables.md to explicitly flag meetings/*.pdf files that have a corresponding *.md source as temp artifacts for deletion, not as deliverables to verify.
